correctness.rationale: For every rank n, the one-based ruler representation is established by induction. Every nonsingleton Lyndon factor must begin at odd a_1 and end at even a_j> a_1; hence it is an aligned image under the two-letter coding phi(a_j)=a_1a_j. Comparing all proper suffixes proves phi(u) is Lyndon iff u is Lyndon, giving induction on rank and the exact forms Z_{i-1}a_j. Each a_j occurs 2^(n-j) times as the center of a Z_j copy; its preceding context is Z_{j-1}, so all and only j stated Lyndon factors end there. Finite geometric sums yield both spectra and total counts, and decreasing Lyndon blocks give the canonical factorization. A from-scratch enumeration verified all factors at every endpoint for n=1,...,9, with separate cyclic-rotation checks at n<=6. This finite check is a consistency check, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of a fundamental ordered-factor invariant for exponentially long unavoidable-pattern words. It compresses all Lyndon factors to n(n+1)/2 explicit forms, gives a lacunary power-of-two length spectrum, computes both distinct and occurrence distributions exactly, and identifies each individual endpoint’s Lyndon suffix lengths via its 2-adic valuation. The pointwise law is meaningful structural information not simply a small numeric increment or an unmotivated slice; the proof provides an effective linear-in-rank compressed description.
